New Suno client for music, remix, sample and sound generation.
New fal client for Seed Audio 1.0.
A 3D scene page is prepared for the scene builder.
New backend support for audio generation with Seed Audio and Suno.
Users can now create audio from Suno and Seed Audio models and play results with waveforms in the gallery.
The environment variable helper library had no tests for its typed getters.
The openssl crate in legacy code is bumped to 0.10.60.
New API endpoints generate meshes and splats.
Kling 1.6 Pro and Seedance 1.0 Lite video generation requests or cost estimates are wrong.
Invalid Seedance video requests, such as prompts that are too long, give server errors instead of clear input errors.
labels.root_cause: Seedance 2.0 limits were not checked, and CJK prompts were not handled before the request was sent to the provider.

labels.symptom: More 3D mesh generation models (Hunyuan 3D 3.1, Meshy v6) are available.
The web app gets new pages for generating 3D objects and 3D worlds.
Generation cost and request endpoints return wrong or unclear validation errors.
labels.root_cause: Router cost errors were not mapped to proper validation responses in the generation handlers.

labels.symptom: Code stops reading and writing deprecated media file fields.
Deprecated columns are dropped from the media files table.
Inference jobs whose model was deleted are not marked as failed.
labels.root_cause: The dependency check did not fail jobs that reference deleted models.

labels.symptom: Media files get a project type field and separate splat and mesh classes.
Project files carry metadata and a legacy 3D editor endpoint is removed.
Mesh and splat files are stored with their specific types instead of a generic dimensional type.
Users can list their project media files through a new endpoint.
Image-to-splat generation with a new model is supported.
Endpoints for the old game-engine editor are removed.
Projects of each editor type can now be saved and updated through new endpoints.
Legacy tag code and endpoints are removed.
Old tags tables are dropped ahead of a rebuild.
Database tables for the new tags system are added.
The sha2 0.10.8 update is reverted.
Media files need a new tagging system with bulk tag operations.
Some 3D model generations fail to import results or report unclear failure reasons.
labels.root_cause: Webhook payload extractors did not cover several 3D model output formats and failure types.

labels.symptom: Audio generation results from the provider were not handled.
Generated results are missing their cover images.
labels.root_cause: Cover image media files were not inserted correctly when processing successful generation webhooks.

labels.symptom: Meshes and splats can be listed in the library and gallery.
Video reference slots can only take uploads, not videos picked from the library.
Paginated result lists fail to load further pages.
labels.root_cause: Pagination sort-key cursors were not encoded or decrypted correctly.

labels.symptom: Various web server endpoints for media, uploads and sessions misbehave.
Meshes and splats can be viewed in a 3D modal.
Server endpoint lists media files that have no folder.
Users can change the visibility of a media file through an update endpoint.
Paginated lists of folders, tags and moderation records return wrong or broken next pages.
labels.root_cause: Opaque pagination cursor handling in list endpoints was incorrect.

labels.symptom: Library can show media not in any folder.
Folders can be sorted in the library and gallery.
Image and video prompt boxes show attached references as a draggable card deck with a new generate button.
Seedream 5.0 Pro image model becomes available for generation.
Weight cover images failed to load because the client called the wrong path; dead API clients removed.
labels.root_cause: Client code targeted backend routes that were never registered or had different paths.

labels.symptom: Mesh and splat media are recognised and handled in galleries and downloads.
Frontend API calls migrated to newer endpoints.
Sidebar order of folders and unfoldered links is swapped.
Inference jobs use the wrong paths for temporary and downloaded files.
labels.root_cause: Inference job types built file and temp-directory paths inconsistently.

labels.symptom: Prompt boxes get a clear-all button.
Media can be tagged and browsed by tag in the library.
Video editor projects can now be saved, listed with thumbnails and reopened.
Moodboards are now saved and kept between sessions.
Media tags can be edited and browsed from the desktop gallery modal.
Audio, 3D and guide-video reference inputs now sit in the prompt box reference deck instead of separate bands.
Settings are added for video preview autoplay and lightbox sound.
Pressing generate does nothing, with no error, when the request is rejected.
labels.root_cause: The API layer discarded server error messages and the failure paths showed no feedback.

labels.symptom: Premium subscription status is now tied to user sessions.
New API endpoints for uploading and managing model weights.
Files can be dragged onto the prompt box to add them as references.
Several video results can be downloaded together, and credits refresh after a failed generation.
Several images can be selected and downloaded together from the create-image page.
Library media can be sent to the create pages as references.
The web app gains a video frame extractor page.
Moderators have no endpoint for killing inference jobs.
The support tool can now pull billing and credit history for reports.
All users can now create API keys.
Mentioning a newly created character uses the wrong character.
labels.root_cause: The create flow stored the inference job token as the character token.

labels.symptom: Character mentions now show as chips, and the mention autocomplete no longer goes off-screen on mobile.
On mobile, picking an audio file opens the photo picker and limit warnings never appear.
labels.root_cause: The file input accept filter fell back to photos on iOS, and shared component toasts went to a toaster the web app did not render.

labels.symptom: Popovers close instantly and the mention autocomplete is unclickable or appears in the top-left corner.
labels.root_cause: Focus handling in the mention textarea and modal interfered with popovers and caret positioning.

labels.symptom: The prompt input freezes at a tag, the add menu hides behind the sidebar, and autocomplete can't scroll in focus mode.
labels.root_cause: Caret could land inside a chip, the menu was clipped by stacking layers, and a scroll lock blocked the autocomplete list.

labels.symptom: Typing a character mention with different capitalisation silently fails to attach the character at generation time.
labels.root_cause: Hand-typed mentions were not normalised to the character's exact name.

labels.symptom: Dependency bump of chrono.
Dropping files onto the desktop window does nothing because the native shell intercepts file drags before the page sees them.
labels.root_cause: The Tauri webview intercepts OS file drag-and-drop events, so HTML drop handlers never fire on desktop.

labels.symptom: A new image generation model is available.
The admin dashboard now shows 3D media correctly and has a databox dashboard list.
No user-visible change; the generation router client is renamed internally.
The Seedance 2.5 Preview video model can now be used for generation.
The third-party API client can now create materials.
A new preview video model is available through the generation API.
Generation fails with 'Not all media files could be found' when the same media file is added as a reference twice.
labels.root_cause: Requests sent duplicate media tokens.

labels.symptom: The task queue and history show raw model IDs and generic icons instead of model names and brand icons.
labels.root_cause: The model name and icon mapping tables were missing entries.

labels.symptom: The async-stripe billing dependency is bumped to 0.26.0.
Download buttons are hidden on the website for now.
A preview model was priced below what it costs to run.
labels.root_cause: The cost table had a negative margin.

labels.symptom: One model configuration was priced below what it costs to run.
labels.root_cause: The cost table had a negative margin.

labels.symptom: Generations with video references were priced below what they cost to run.
labels.root_cause: The video-reference cost calculation had a negative margin.

labels.symptom: Some video and image models were priced below what they cost to run.
labels.root_cause: Cost tables in the model providers had negative margins.

labels.symptom: Generation endpoints now accept either an API key or a web session.
Dependency bump of rustix.
Minimax H3 video models can now be used for generation.
On touch devices the mention autocomplete list can't be scrolled, taps sometimes don't register, and the popup appears in the wrong place.
labels.root_cause: Touch drag was handled as a selection, and the popup position was not anchored to the mention after an edit.

labels.symptom: Character images can be viewed full size, and mobile drawers get a close button and swipe-down to dismiss.
Flux 3 and Flux 3 Draft video models can now be used for generation.
Media files now record which job produced them.
A new API endpoint lists the media files a generation job produced.
The website gets a beta sign-up page.
Scripts are removed from the beta sign-up page.
Dependency bump of lettre.
Admins can ban several user accounts at once from the signups page.
Deploy build fails while bundling a web worker with Vite.
labels.root_cause: Worker import was not compatible with the Vite build.

labels.symptom: There is no backend endpoint that lists a user's media files.
Cost estimates for a video generation model are wrong.
Listing a user's media files fails or returns wrong values because of column-name and type mismatches.
labels.root_cause: The query builder mapped rows by the wrong column names and did not convert enum types properly.

labels.symptom: Video generation jobs are billed incorrectly.
Fixes the database code generation script and regenerates the sqlx query cache.
Removes unused video model enums and providers.
Adds batch-size support to video generation.
A new endpoint lists media files from all users.
Image mentions in the prompt show as thumbnail chips, and the chip preview now opens the full-resolution image.
Margins in video generation cost calculations needed adjusting.
In fullscreen mode the prompt box text gets cut off instead of scrolling.
labels.root_cause: The textarea wrapper lacked min-h-0, so as a flex child it kept its full content height and was clipped.

labels.symptom: With many reference images, the reference deck overflows fullscreen mode and squeezes the text editor.
labels.root_cause: The expanded deck had no width limit and used shrink-0, so it could not shrink inside its flex row.

labels.symptom: A local Swagger/OpenAPI docs server now lists the API endpoints.
Moves the pricing code so it is easier to test.
Generating Seedream images in batches did not work correctly.
Veo video generation was priced below cost.
Pasting long text into the prompt box is very slow, and a dropdown submenu won't scroll inside a fullscreen modal.
labels.root_cause: execCommand insertText takes quadratic time per line in Chromium, and the modal's scroll lock swallowed wheel and touch events on panels rendered in a portal.

labels.symptom: Video generation requests sent a default resolution the user had not picked.
Columns in the subscription database tables were renamed and changed.
A chrono upgrade broke the build and was reverted.
labels.root_cause: chrono 0.4.31 was incompatible with the limitation crate.

labels.symptom: Video requests fell back to 720p without saying so.
labels.root_cause: The request type used 720p as a hidden default resolution.

labels.symptom: The legacy video endpoint charged different prices than the newer endpoint.
Some video generation prices were set below cost, so they lost money.
labels.root_cause: The Seedance cost calculation set the margin too low.

labels.symptom: Updates the pricing rates for generation providers.
Adds 1080p output for Seedance 2.5 video generation.
An unmaintained rate-limiter dependency breaks when other libraries are upgraded.
labels.root_cause: The limitation crate is stuck at 0.1.1 and incompatible with newer chrono.

labels.symptom: Media you have already viewed now shows a last-viewed badge.
On iOS, adding several image prompts makes the page reload and lose the prompts, and the upload card flickers when an upload finishes.
labels.root_cause: Every uploaded image was kept as a full-resolution base64 data URL just to show a small thumbnail, which ran past the browser's memory limit.

labels.symptom: Dropping files onto the prompt does nothing while the fullscreen focus mode is open.
labels.root_cause: The focus-mode modal covers the inline drop zone and has no drop zone of its own.

labels.symptom: The website's UI primitives get a square, brutalist restyle.
Adds a core UI kit to the new website.
Adds a Billing tab with plan management to the settings modal.
The web app's styling is refreshed.
Adds MCP session management to the API.
After you recreate a generation, the quoted cost is much higher than the original charge.
labels.root_cause: Restored reference media was given a duration of 0, so the quote was priced at the worst-case maximum.

labels.symptom: Upgrading chrono broke the rate limiter until the vendored crate was patched.
labels.root_cause: The limitation crate used chrono APIs that changed in newer versions.

labels.symptom: Backend generation jobs get stuck and never finish.
labels.root_cause: Database and HTTP calls had no timeouts and job loops had no staleness health check.

labels.symptom: Adds a creator spotlight page to the website.
Adds more generation providers.
Requests to the fal image/video service fail with a client error.
Adds the gpt-image-2.5 image model.
If you close a media lightbox quickly, the whole page stops responding to clicks and nothing on screen shows why.
labels.root_cause: Radix Dialog with forceMount and a spring-driven exit animation never clears the pointer-events:none it sets on the body when the close animation is interrupted.

labels.symptom: The marketing website gets a scroll ruler and heading flow.
Text-to-speech results are now saved as media files.
Agent instruction files renamed from CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md.
Generation and cost-estimate requests through the omni APIs fail in the desktop app.
Version bumped to 0.37.
The marketing website gets a new spiral hero graphic.
The repository carries backend services and web frontends unrelated to the desktop app.
Stale docs and files clutter the repo.
A no-op release to check that builds still work after the repo reset.
Release builds in CI fail on a clean machine without cached build output.
labels.root_cause: The CI workflow relied on leftover build caches instead of building everything from scratch.

labels.symptom: Unneeded mut bindings in database query builders cause compiler warnings.
A no-op release to check that CI builds work after the fix.
The README needs updating.
Midjourney image generation fails or behaves unreliably.
New generation models and output formats are not available.
Version bump release.
Users can't log in to the desktop app through the website.
New release that adds login through the website.
The login screen video doesn't play in the desktop app.
Switching between tabs in the main app is slow.
Front-end nx dependency is outdated.
The local dev script is slow or awkward to use.
API requests don't identify the client with a consistent origin and user agent.
The desktop app's look doesn't match the web app's design.
Gallery thumbnails load slowly and some never render.
The app icon and favicons show the old logo.
Front-end undici dependency is outdated.
The front-end axios dependency is outdated.
OBJ, STL and PLY 3D models cannot be uploaded.
3D viewers leak GPU memory on the desktop because textures and geometry are never released.
labels.root_cause: Three.js objects weren't disposed when the view unmounted.

labels.symptom: Favorites are renamed to user bookmarks and stored in a new table.
AI agents have no MCP server for driving generation tools.
The app shows a blank screen at startup when reading from browser storage is denied.
labels.root_cause: An unguarded localStorage read in the task queue throws while the component is starting up.

labels.symptom: Dependency bump of hyper-tls.
Adds a film simulation effect to the paint surface.
On Linux the window opens larger than the screen and grows on every launch, and startup crashes on NVIDIA under Wayland.
labels.root_cause: With fractional scaling, GTK reports an integer scale factor, so the saved window size does not round-trip; the default size is too large; and WebKitGTK fails on NVIDIA under Wayland.

labels.symptom: There is no Linux release, and custom window buttons are drawn on top of the native ones on Linux.
labels.root_cause: There was no Linux publish workflow, and the custom title-bar buttons were shown on every platform except macOS.

labels.symptom: Copying files out of the temp directory fails when the target is on a different drive.
labels.root_cause: TempDir defaults to /tmp, and copies from it to a different filesystem sometimes fail.

labels.symptom: Premium plans now allow longer TTS generation.
Dependency bump of tokio.
Images uploaded from the upload modal never show up in the asset library.
labels.root_cause: uploadImage left out is_intermediate_system_file, which defaults to true, so user uploads were stored as hidden system files.

labels.symptom: No Linux installer, and the installed app has an incomplete desktop entry and wrongly sized icons.
labels.root_cause: The bundle had no Linux release build and was missing desktop entry metadata; a 2x 128 px icon was installed as a 256 px icon.

labels.symptom: Dependency bump of version-sync.
New users cannot sign up.
The app shows a blank screen when the browser blocks access to local storage.
labels.root_cause: A localStorage read in a component's state initializer had no guard, so a denied read threw during render.

labels.symptom: The dev database seeder can now add media files.
Login errors show technical messages instead of user-friendly ones.
Version bump.
Running the dev database seeder twice fails or creates duplicate media files.
labels.root_cause: The media file seeding was not idempotent.

labels.symptom: On Linux with the NVIDIA driver under Wayland, the app crashes at launch or the webview is transparent, black or draws video over the UI.
labels.root_cause: A WebKitGTK explicit-sync bug on NVIDIA with linux-drm-syncobj-v1, which __NV_DISABLE_EXPLICIT_SYNC=1 works around.

labels.symptom: Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: No Flatpak build or hosted, signed OSTree repository exists for releases.

labels.symptom: No Linux builds are published.
labels.root_cause: There is no Linux publish workflow.

labels.symptom: The New Relic telemetry dependency in backend jobs was hard to keep upgraded.
CI workflows show Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: The workflows pin GitHub Actions versions that run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

labels.symptom: The project is under a fair-source license instead of MIT OR Apache-2.0.
The HTML sanitizer dependency is out of date and missing hardening fixes.
labels.root_cause: Outdated dompurify 3.4.8.

labels.symptom: A source-map dependency is open to a denial of service.
labels.root_cause: Vulnerable source-map-js 1.2.1.

labels.symptom: A CSS selector parser dependency is open to CPU exhaustion.
labels.root_cause: Vulnerable postcss-selector-parser 6.1.2.

labels.symptom: A front-end dependency (proxy-addr) has a known CVE.
labels.root_cause: Vulnerable proxy-addr version 2.0.7.

labels.symptom: A front-end dependency (handlebars) has known security advisories.
labels.root_cause: Vulnerable handlebars version 4.7.9.

labels.symptom: Front-end build tooling (nx) is out of date.
A new inference job type re-renders a video.
On Linux Wayland the release build crashes at startup with a WebKit protocol error.
labels.root_cause: The WebKitGTK DMABUF renderer crashes on Wayland, and only the dev scripts disabled it.

labels.symptom: On first launch the sign-in screen covers the minimize, maximize and close buttons, so the window cannot be moved or closed.
labels.root_cause: The full-screen login overlay has a higher z-index than the custom title bar in an undecorated window.

labels.symptom: The Windows dev build fails at CMake configure with 'Could not create named generator', or because libclang is missing.
labels.root_cause: An older CMake on PATH (from Strawberry Perl) does not know the newest Visual Studio generator, and bindgen needs libclang, which was not installed.

labels.symptom: While generation jobs are pending, the app opens a new connection on every poll and fills the logs with repeated warnings.
labels.root_cause: A new HTTP client was created for each poll request, skipped tasks were logged at warn level, and the job-list dedupe compared the wrong value.

labels.symptom: There is no native desktop app without a webview for creating images and videos.
The app uses the native window frame instead of a custom title bar and layout.
Animated objects with custom easing curves jump straight to their final position.
labels.root_cause: The unbracketed Newton solver in the cubic bezier evaluation returns endpoint values on flat curves.

labels.symptom: AI streamer accounts need their own rate limits for text-to-speech requests.
Downloaded files can get a wrong extension taken from a directory or an opaque URL.
labels.root_cause: The extractor took a suffix from the whole URL instead of only its final file path segment.

labels.symptom: Truncated or corrupt base64 data URLs are accepted instead of rejected.
labels.root_cause: The data URL was split so that only part of the payload reached the base64 validator.

labels.symptom: Typing a calculation with a leading decimal such as '.5 * 100' in a numeric field puts back the old value.
labels.root_cause: The expression tokenizer did not accept numbers that start with a decimal point.

labels.symptom: Media from the CDN can fail to load because of CORS when its URL already has a query string or fragment.
labels.root_cause: The helper always appended '?cors=1', which corrupts URLs that already have a query or fragment.

labels.symptom: Pressing Enter to confirm an IME candidate inserts a newline or submits the prompt instead.
labels.root_cause: Key handlers did not check whether IME composition was active.

labels.symptom: Leaving a project while an autosave is running can lose the latest edits, and a failed save on exit gives no chance to retry.
labels.root_cause: saveNow returned early while an autosave was in flight, and the header navigated away in a finally block even when saving failed.

labels.symptom: Polling background generation jobs is slow, and the websocket client can stall or deadlock.
labels.root_cause: A std RwLock guard was held across await, and pending jobs were polled one after another instead of concurrently.

labels.symptom: Adds audio creation, in-app playback, animated previews and character mentions.
Rate limits on upload and inference endpoints do not work as intended.
After refreshing or changing the filter, the generation history can show stale results or a wrong loading state.
labels.root_cause: A reset did not invalidate in-flight requests, so an older response could overwrite the newer one.

labels.symptom: Removing a media reference during an upload brings it back when the upload finishes, and parallel uploads overwrite each other.
labels.root_cause: Async completions committed against stale snapshots of the reference lists.

labels.symptom: After undoing several media deletions, restored media appear in the bin but cannot be read.
labels.root_cause: Each undo restores a whole snapshot of the media array, which brings back object URLs that were already revoked.

labels.symptom: The dev database seed tool can now add model weights.
Reference audio keeps playing after its tile is removed, with no way to stop it.
labels.root_cause: The audio element was not paused on unmount or URL replacement, and callbacks from stale elements were not ignored.

labels.symptom: Media pasted or imported just before switching project or scene ends up in the new project or scene.
labels.root_cause: Delayed imports were not bound to the project and scene that started them, and the manager discarded the project ID.

labels.symptom: Saved project storage connections stay open, which can block later database upgrades.
labels.root_cause: The IndexedDB transaction helper never closed the connections it opened.

labels.symptom: After deleting the selected scene or undoing a scene switch, the saved project still points to the wrong or deleted scene.
labels.root_cause: Scene commands updated the active scene in the manager but not the persisted currentSceneId in the project document.

labels.symptom: Dropping a provider outside the list moves it to the end and saves the new priority order.
labels.root_cause: A null drop target became index -1, and the reorder was saved anyway.

labels.symptom: Very thin images import but show a blank thumbnail.
labels.root_cause: Rounding while scaling the thumbnail produced a zero-sized canvas.

labels.symptom: Dragging to scrub a number field keeps changing the value after the field disappears or the window loses focus.
labels.root_cause: Document pointer listeners were not removed when the field unmounted or the pointer lock was lost.

labels.symptom: A job that has finished shows up again as pending in the generation feed.
labels.root_cause: Poll responses that arrived out of order overwrote newer state.

labels.symptom: Failed TTS inference jobs now record failure details.
A new endpoint lists featured model weights.
Waveforms are downloaded twice after the cache is cleared while a request is still running.
labels.root_cause: A stale failed request's catch handler deleted the newer replacement cache entry.

labels.symptom: Dropping or pasting an M4A audio file into the prompt box rejects it or treats it as video.
labels.root_cause: Some platforms report .m4a as video/mp4, and the router trusted the MIME type before the audio-file check.

labels.symptom: Still frames cannot be extracted from a local video.
There is no local shot list board for planning scenes.
Tests and seed tools can create the same token values every run using a deterministic random number generator.
The native app can only generate through its own service, not Midjourney or fal.
Comments, bookmarks and ratings check entity tokens polymorphically and support new token types.
The profile media list endpoint now uses the public pagination format.
Logging out does not end the session, because the cached session stays in place.
labels.root_cause: The users component's logout handler had no binding to purge the Redis session cache; that hook was defined only in the billing component.

labels.symptom: Command-line tools fail to build after the clap upgrade from 2.x to 4.x.
labels.root_cause: The clap 4 API is not compatible with argument parsing code written for clap 2.

labels.symptom: The database schema gains model weight migration tokens, cover and avatar images, and sample media.
Model weight files get their own bucket path descriptors.
Public media file list pages return items at the wrong offset.
labels.root_cause: The public pagination offset was calculated incorrectly in the media file list queries.

labels.symptom: Local development can now run on Kubernetes.
Dependency update of the windows-sys crate.
Dependency update of bcrypt that adds constant-time password hash comparison.
Videos can be re-rendered through a video filter inference job.
The dev database seed tool writes wrong file paths, prefixes, suffixes and bucket hashes for model weights.
labels.root_cause: The seeding code built model weight paths and bucket hashes wrongly.

labels.symptom: Moves voice conversion models into the model_weights table, with double writes and a migration tool.
Migrating voice conversion models to model weights fails or copies files incorrectly.
Voice conversion jobs stay queued after their model has been deleted, instead of failing.
labels.root_cause: The dependency check failed jobs with deleted models only for TTS jobs, not voice conversion jobs.

labels.symptom: Some bucket file paths are built incorrectly, and tests fail.
Voice conversion can now be done on the web, with a large refactor.
Cleans up the voice conversion to weights migration tool.
Adds a cursor-based query for migrating TTS models.
Download jobs are not picked up, and the media file list API returns wrong results.
Adds an endpoint for uploading media files.
Model weight bucket fields are renamed from private to public.
Users can set an avatar image on model weights.
The weight detail endpoint now includes creator details.
Adds API documentation for the user bookmark endpoints.
The profile weights list switches to public pagination.
Adds a shared file-descriptor library for uploading and downloading cloud bucket files.
A basic CI workflow was added.
Weight list and detail endpoints now include avatar images.
Model weight avatar fields are renamed to cover_image.
Paging through media file and bookmark lists returns wrong or missing pages.
The single weight API response lacks updated_at, and the profile weights list lacks weights_category.
labels.root_cause: The endpoints left these fields out of their response structs.

labels.symptom: The user's weights list returns the wrong weight type field.
labels.root_cause: The list-weights-by-user endpoint mapped the weights type incorrectly.

labels.symptom: Model weight descriptions are now optional.
Small query builder updates for editing weights and paging through the weights explore list.
Profile and list pages showed the wrong items depending on whether the user was logged in.
labels.root_cause: List queries ignored visibility and login state; logged-out users should get only public results, and logged-in users and moderators should get results based on visibility.

labels.symptom: Bookmark lists can be filtered.
The server now computes TTS model category assignments.
Bookmark results now include model data.
Media file details now include information about the model.
Fetching a single weight applied the wrong authorization.
labels.root_cause: The get-weight endpoint checked authorization incorrectly.

labels.symptom: Bookmarked model weights now show a cover image.
Bookmarks now include the media file's path and type.
A weight's cover image can be changed through the update endpoint.
Media file details now include the model weight's creator and cover image.
API fields named weights_* are renamed to weight_*.
Bookmark lists now include creator details for weights and media files.
Synthetic categories were added, including a latest models category.
Listing a user's weights returned results that weren't scoped correctly.
labels.root_cause: The list-weights-by-user query was missing scoping conditions.

labels.symptom: The list-available-weights API uses strongly typed fields.
Adding or removing a bookmark now returns the updated bookmark count.
Setting a rating now returns the item's total rating count.
User ratings for many items can be fetched in one request.
Bookmark status for many items can be fetched in one request.
Stable Diffusion image generation jobs are supported.
Model weight statistics are moved out of the main table into a separate stats table.
StyleTTS2 can be used as a voice designer model.
Bookmark stats are recorded for each item.
Trending voices are now listed using model usage analytics.
Rating stats are collected when users rate items.
The inference job service now emits OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
Dependency update of the crossbeam-utils crate.
MocapNet motion capture can be run on videos.
Media and bookmark list endpoints now include stats.
Model weights can be backfilled into Elasticsearch search indexing (work in progress).
The StyleTTS2 model downloader is cleaned up and generated query files are refreshed.
Creating a zero-shot voice fails when more than one audio sample is given.
labels.root_cause: Voice creation did not ignore extra samples beyond the first.

labels.symptom: New database tables are added for idempotency tokens and batch generations.
Batch generation records are saved in the database.
Users can now say why they are unsubscribing.
Dependency update of zerocopy that fixes a soundness advisory (RUSTSEC-2023-0074).
